messages:
Olivia: Quick heads-up — we need an expedited hotfix for 1.10.8. Routing regression causes occasional 503s under burst traffic. Aim: minimal diff, patch bump, canary, then prod. Cutoff in 30m. Who can own backport + smoke QA?
Raj: I can take the backport. Which commit(s) do we cherry-pick?
Olivia: The fix is in main: commit abc1234. Backport into release/1.10 -> patch/1.10.8. Keep changes limited to router/*. Do NOT include unrelated deps.
Raj: Got it. I’ll prepare patch/1.10.8 and run unit tests. Any exemptions for full e2e?
Simon: Skip full integration for initial canary — run unit + router smoke + lint. Then canary to 5% for 10m with op eyes. If stable, promote.
Jen: I’ll handle the version bump and changelog entry once patch branch is available. Reminder: package.json and helm/chart appVersion both need sync.
Maria: Runbook check — if canary fails, immediate rollback to 1.10.7 tag and open incident channel. I’ll standby for rollback ops. Also make sure observability alerts are unmuted.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary window: 10:20–10:30 UTC for patch/1.10.8 -> canary pool (5%). Auto-promote disabled.
Raj: Branch created: patch/1.10.8. Cherry-pick done: abc1234. Ran unit tests: all green. Pushed to origin and added PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4452 :party_face:.
Jen: Working on package bumps and changelog. Changelog snippet: "Fix: routing under burst causing 503s (cherry-picked abc1234)". Will push commit and tag v1.10.8-rc.1
Olivia: Perfect. Quick reminder — keep config diffs out. No schema changes.
Simon: Launching canary now (manual). I’ll attach smoke commands.
Simon: Smoke test snippet:
```
curl -H "Host: api.redwood.ai" https://canary.example/predict -d '{"text":"hello"}' -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" | grep -q 200 && echo ok || echo fail
```
Simon: Canary at 5% started. Observability: dashboards up, traces sampled.
Maria: I’ve unmuted alerts and watching SLOs. Notifying oncall.
Jen: Pushed version bump and changelog, created tag v1.10.8-rc.1. PR updated.
Raj: Noticed one minor lint in router/validate.go — fixed and force-pushed. Unit tests still green.
Simon: After 7m metrics look steady. No 5xx spike.
Olivia: If no regressions by 10m, promote to 100%. Everyone OK with manual promote? :thumbsup:
Jen: +1
Raj: +1
Simon: +1
Maria: +1
Olivia: Going to promote in 3m then. I’ll post final deploy tag and close thread after prod is green.
deploy-bot: Promotion started: patch/1.10.8 -> production pool.
Simon: Prod rollout in progress. Monitoring closely.
Maria: No new 500s, latency stable.
Raj: Tag v1.10.8 created and pushed.
Jen: Changelog published on release notes page.
Olivia: Thanks everyone — hotfix complete, minimal diff as planned. Closing the loop: 1.10.8 deployed, rollback plan in runbook, release notes published. :tada:
Raj: Nice work.
Simon: Great job team.
Maria: Closing incident watchers.
deploy-bot: Thread archived.
